result.instructions: Tools for GitHub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my pull requests are still open, and which have failing workflow runs?"; "List the open issues labelled bug in octocat/Hello-World, newest first."; "Show the changed files and review status of pull request 42 in our main repo.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GitHub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run github_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run github_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run github_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. github_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: github_get_authenticated_user
tools.title: Get the authenticated user
tools.description: Return the GitHub account the token belongs to (login, name, plan, public repo count). Good first call to confirm which account is connected. REST: GET /user.

tools.name: github_list_my_repos
tools.title: List my repositories
tools.description: List repositories the token can access: owned, collaborator and organization repositories. Filter by visibility or affiliation. REST: GET /user/repos.

affiliation.description: Comma-separated: owner, collaborator, organization_member (default all three).

tools.name: github_list_my_orgs
tools.title: List my organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the authenticated user belongs to. REST: GET /user/orgs.

tools.name: github_get_repo
tools.title: Get a repository
tools.description: Return one repository: default branch, visibility, language, stars, open issue count, last push time. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

tools.name: github_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List branches of a repository. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

tools.name: github_list_releases
tools.title: List releases
tools.description: List releases of a repository, newest first. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

tools.name: github_list_commits
tools.title: List commits
tools.description: List commits on a branch, tag or SHA, optionally for one file path or author and a date range. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

sha.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA to list from (default: default branch).

path.description: Only commits that touched this file or directory path.

author.description: GitHub login or email of the author.

tools.name: github_get_commit
tools.title: Get a commit
tools.description: Return one commit with its message, author, stats and changed files (with patch text). REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch or tag name.

tools.name: github_list_issues
tools.title: List issues
tools.description: List issues of a repository. The API also returns pull requests here; check the pull_request field. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names, e.g. bug,help wanted.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp: only issues updated after this time.

tools.name: github_get_issue
tools.title: Get an issue
tools.description: Return one issue with its body, labels, assignees and state. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

issue_number.description: Issue number shown in the URL, e.g. 42.

tools.name: github_list_issue_comments
tools.title: List issue comments
tools.description: List comments on an issue or pull request conversation. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/comments.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

issue_number.description: Issue number shown in the URL, e.g. 42.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp: only comments updated after this time.

tools.name: github_list_pull_requests
tools.title: List pull requests
tools.description: List pull requests of a repository. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

head.description: Filter by head branch, as user:branch.

tools.name: github_get_pull_request
tools.title: Get a pull request
tools.description: Return one pull request: title, body, state, merge status, head and base branches, author. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

pull_number.description: Pull request number shown in the URL, e.g. 7.

tools.name: github_list_pull_request_files
tools.title: List pull request files
tools.description: List files changed by a pull request, with status, additions, deletions and patch text. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/files.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

pull_number.description: Pull request number shown in the URL, e.g. 7.

tools.name: github_list_pull_request_reviews
tools.title: List pull request reviews
tools.description: List reviews on a pull request (approved, changes requested, commented). REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

pull_number.description: Pull request number shown in the URL, e.g. 7.

tools.name: github_list_workflow_runs
tools.title: List workflow runs
tools.description: List GitHub Actions workflow runs of a repository, newest first. Filter by branch, event, status or actor. REST: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

event.description: Trigger event, e.g. push or pull_request.

actor.description: Login of the user who triggered the run.

tools.name: github_search_repositories
tools.title: Search repositories
tools.description: Search public and accessible repositories with GitHub qualifiers (language:, stars:, topic:, user:). Search has a lower rate limit than other reads. REST: GET /search/repositories.

q.description: GitHub search query with qualifiers, e.g. 'mcp language:typescript stars:>100'.

tools.name: github_search_issues
tools.title: Search issues and pull requests
tools.description: Search issues and pull requests with qualifiers such as repo:, is:issue, is:pr, is:open, label:, author:. Search has a lower rate limit than other reads. REST: GET /search/issues.

q.description: GitHub search query with qualifiers, e.g. 'mcp language:typescript stars:>100'.

tools.name: github_create_issue
tools.title: Create an issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a repository. Visible to everyone who can read the repository. Requires issues write permission. REST: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

tools.name: github_add_issue_comment
tools.title: Add an issue comment
tools.description: Post a comment on an issue or pull request conversation. Visible to everyone who can read the repository. REST: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/comments.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

issue_number.description: Issue number shown in the URL, e.g. 42.

tools.name: github_update_issue
tools.title: Update an issue
tools.description: Change an issue's title, body, state (open or closed), labels or assignees. A given labels or assignees list replaces the current one. REST: PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, e.g. octocat.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner, e.g. Hello-World.

issue_number.description: Issue number shown in the URL, e.g. 42.

labels.description: Replaces all labels with this list.

assignees.description: Replaces all assignees with this list.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with GitHub
prompts.description: What you can do with GitHub here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_open_pull_requests_and_failing_workflow_runs
prompts.title: Check open pull requests and failing workflow runs
prompts.description: List the pull requests of a repository and read one with its reviews. List the workflow runs to see which ones failed.

prompts.name: review_the_files_changed_in_a_pull_request
prompts.title: Review the files changed in a pull request
prompts.description: Read a pull request with its branches and state. Then read its changed files with the patch text and the commits on its branch.

prompts.name: find_issues_and_read_their_discussion
prompts.title: Find issues and read their discussion
prompts.description: Search issues and pull requests with GitHub qualifiers such as repo, label or state. Open one issue and read its comments.

prompts.name: open_a_bug_report_and_add_the_steps_to_reproduce
prompts.title: Open a bug report and add the steps to reproduce
prompts.description: Create a new issue in a repository. Then add a comment with the steps to reproduce it. Everyone who can read the repository sees both.

prompts.name: find_popular_repositories_by_topic
prompts.title: Find popular repositories by topic
prompts.description: Search public and accessible repositories with qualifiers such as language or stars. Open one to read its default branch and last push time.
